Tentative slot: Tuesday, Mar 16 at 9:00 AM PT (16:00 UTC). For quick reference: that would be
- 9:00 AM PT / 12:00 PM ET / 16:00 UTC
- 17:00 CET (if any EU folks join)
- 03:00 AEDT (next day) for Sydney — not ideal for APAC.

A couple of notes: the US clock jumps forward on Sun Mar 14 (local DST), which will shift US wall times relative to EU/APAC for a couple of weeks until Australia/NZ return to standard time in April. I want to avoid a follow-up reschedule if possible. If Mar 16 works for you, we’ll keep it; otherwise we can propose late-March slots that are friendlier to Sydney.

Do you have a hard preference (US-friendly evening vs APAC morning)? I can coordinate alternative options with my SE (Lukas) and APAC rep (Hiro).

Thanks,

Hi Ben — thanks for the invite. We're based in Sydney (AEDT) and have a board review the week of Mar 15, so daytime there is tight. A couple of clarifications:

- Mar 16 at 03:00 AEDT would be very hard for our engineering team.
- Also worth flagging that Australia ends their DST on Sun Apr 4 — our clocks will move back an hour then, so any early-April slots shift again.

To avoid moving this twice, could we either:
1) pick a late-March time that is ~07:00–09:00 AEDT (which is late afternoon/evening US on the previous day), or
2) do the demo in the second week of April after the Australia clock change (we're much more flexible Apr 5–9).

Option 2 might be easiest for us since it avoids the board week and the DST flip. If Redwood needs a pre-April sync, suggest Mar 31 at 18:00 UTC (Mar 31 11:00 PDT) — Jonas and I could join for a brief alignment but prefer the full demo post-April 4.

Best,

Thanks Ben — proposing two confirmed options below with explicit conversions to reduce confusion. I've attached a cleaned agenda and the calendar invite stub (redwood-demo-bridge-ics.ics).

Option A — Late March alignment (shorter notice)
- Proposed: Wed, Mar 31, 2027 18:00 UTC (Wed Mar 31 11:00 PDT / Thu Apr 1 05:00 AEDT) — 45 mins
- Converts to: 11:00 PDT (US), 14:00 EDT (US east), 19:00 CET, 05:00 AEDT next day (Sydney)
- Pros: still before Australia DST change; good for EU/US evening attendance
- Cons: very early for Sydney (they warned that 05:00 is rough)

Option B — Post-Australia cutover (preferred for APAC)
- Proposed: Tue, Apr 6, 2027 00:00 UTC (Mon Apr 5 17:00 PDT / Tue Apr 6 11:00 AEDT) — 45 mins
- Converts to: 17:00 PDT (US west), 20:00 EDT (US east), 01:00 CEST next day, 11:00 AEDT (Sydney)
- Pros: comfortable for Sydney and APAC; avoids the board week

Suggested agenda (attached):
1) 15m — product walkthrough (redwood API + Dedicated)
2) 10m — deployment/SLAs + compliance note
3) 15m — SE deep dive: cost/latency examples + KV cache demo
4) 5m — next steps + docs/hubspot links

If you confirm Option B we'll send calendar invite and SE prep notes. If Redwood needs to keep some US late-evening availability, we can add a canary slot on Apr 7 at 02:00 UTC.
